name: Bessie Head
shortBio: South African-born Botswanan philosopher-novelist of exile, psychological fracture, and agrarian communal ethics who interrogated the metaphysics of good, evil, and belonging.
centralQuestion: How does the stateless exile survive psychic colonization to forge an ordinary, egalitarian ethics of the village?

keyWorks.title: Maru
keyWorks.description: Philosophical examination of intra-African racial prejudice, marginality, and moral courage in postcolonial Botswana.

keyWorks.title: A Question of Power
keyWorks.description: Autobiographical phenomenology of madness, apartheid trauma, and the struggle between absolute power and everyday human reverence.
